source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 14 June 1930, p. 9 ("Fermanagh L.G. elections: Nationalists win Enniskillen"); Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1930, p. 9 ("Fermanagh results: Nationalists win Enniskillen division")
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Votes as printed in both papers; 827-760=67, printed majority 67.

note: Triennial election of Fermanagh County Council, polled Wednesday 4 June 1930 (Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1930: polling 'took place yesterday in the contested County Council divisions of Fermanagh'). Results declared 5 June. Twenty county divisions; three contested, the remainder returned unopposed. The full nominations list of 10 May 1930 supplies the Hollywell member and all the unopposed names. Structure and division names for the 1966-67 amalgamation are in notes/fermanagh-fcra-1969.md, from Fermanagh CRA, 'Fermanagh Facts' (1969). That is an advocacy pamphlet: use it for names only, not figures. Its register figures are disputed by Kingsley (2021) on the Omagh Rural District scheme. Read the page image before recording any number from it.
